finding: npm run validate:standard reports failed (passed=75, failed=12, total=87) at 554092cd1, the commit currently on origin/main. The reds are pre-existing and unrelated to any single lane: git diff --name-only 554092cd1 c486a5041 covers only ATM-GOV-0353. They were also reproduced with the ATM-GOV-0353 planning-root cache disabled, so that change is excluded as a cause. Triage by root cause: (1) validate-multi-agent-confidence - docs/multi-agent-compatibility-matrix.md was stale against scripts/render-agent-matrix.ts; repaired by regenerating. (2) validate-bridge-minor - ordering asserted against the CI step label 'Compute gate standard', which release-npm.yml renamed to 'Compute gate full with resumable receipt', so indexOf returned -1; repaired under ATM-GOV-0354. (3) validate-branch-commit-queue - three anchors; two were path and quote-style defects repaired under ATM-GOV-0354, the third is a genuine contract loss tracked as ATM-BUG-2026-08-13-001. (4) validate-broker-registry - the fixture asserts that an atom ID/CID overlap alone yields blocked-cid-conflict, but decision.ts now gates that on hasSharedWriteSurface, and the fixture's intents target disjoint files (src/file-a.ts against src/file-b.ts), so the observed parallel-safe verdict follows the current documented rule. validate-brokered-write and validate-broker-steward fail in the same family and are unconfirmed. (5) validate-task-direction-governance, validate-framework-development-governance, validate-framework-governance-repairs and validate-framework-hook-scope-filtering fail on hook and direction-lock behaviour, the sharpest being a fixture that expects cross-file consistency to block a commit while it now allows it. (6) validate-task-ledger-governance fails when its repair-closure fixture spawns atm.dev.mjs git commit for TASK-REPAIR-CLOSURE-0001; the child exits 1 with stdout and stderr captured as null so the profile log shows no ATM code. A scratch-repo probe of the same command shape returns ATM_WRITE_TICKET_MISSING, so the likely cause is that the fixture provisions a claim without minting a work-admission ticket, which governed commit began requiring after the fixture was written. The suppressed child output is itself a defect: a validator that cannot show why its own fixture failed cannot be triaged from its log. (7) validate-skew-matrix took 192686ms against a 180000ms budget, which is the timing-margin flake the runbook already owns as WP-03A, not a new failure.
expectedBehavior: The standard profile must be green before the closeout gate can be believed, and each red must resolve into exactly one of three dispositions with evidence: a stale artifact or anchor that is repaired without weakening what it asserts; a genuine contract loss that is restored or deliberately replaced with the assertion updated in the same change; or a fixture that encodes superseded semantics and is rewritten to test both sides of the current rule. No red may be closed by deleting or loosening its assertion alone.
